executive_summary: Liquidity first: the Expand case breaches runway in year 1 without staged funding. Recommend a staged expansion gated on pilot traction.

recommendations.title: Stage the expansion in two tranches
recommendations.rationale: Keeps the move reversible and caps downside to the first tranche.
recommendations.what_would_change_this: Churn above 10%/yr makes Do nothing the better option.

continue_vs_change.rationale: Market growth outweighs runway risk if staged.

risks.title: Cash runway shorter than payback
risks.mitigation: Second tranche only after month-6 gate.

disclaimer: Not legal, tax or financial advice. Figures are estimates with stated ranges.
